title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds 66,188 dollars with a 1.1 percent gain despite extreme fear at 25 on the index. Hashrate steadies at 911 EH/s, confirming miner commitment through the dip. Mempool backlog hits 94,757 transactions yet fees remain cheap at 5 sat per vbyte, pointing to routine rather than urgent flows. Block 959,038 confirms steady network progress. US morning trade shows quiet resilience with no fresh catalysts breaking the tape.
